name: RepoHamster Challenge Workspace
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip --quiet 2>/dev/null || true && (test -f requirements.txt && pip install -r requirements.txt || true) && (for r in backend/requirements.txt server/requirements.txt api/requirements.txt app/requirements.txt; do test -f "$r" && pip install -r "$r" || true; done) && (test -f pyproject.toml && (pip install -e . 2>/dev/null || pip install . 2>/dev/null) || true) && pip install pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-cov --quiet 2>/dev/null || true && (test -f package.json && npm install || true) && (test -f frontend/package.json && (cd frontend && npm install) || true) && (test -f client/package.json && (cd client && npm install) || true) && (test -f .env.example && test ! -f .env && cp .env.example .env || true) && (sudo chown -R root:root .vscode 2>/dev/null || true) && (chmod 444 .vscode/settings.json .github/copilot-instructions.md .cursorrules .windsurfrules CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null || true) && echo "🚀 [RepoHamster] Workspace is fully configured and ready!"'
